description: This policy setting controls whether or not exclusions are visible to local users. If HideExclusionsFromLocalAdmins is set then this policy will be implicitly set.

options.displayName: If you enable this setting, local users will no longer be able to see the exclusion list in Windows Security App or via PowerShell.
options.description: If you enable this setting, local users will no longer be able to see the exclusion list in Windows Security App or via PowerShell.

options.displayName: If you disable or do not configure this setting, local users will be able to see exclusions in the Windows Security App and via PowerShell.
options.description: If you disable or do not configure this setting, local users will be able to see exclusions in the Windows Security App and via PowerShell.
